name: Slack
description: Let agents read and post in the Slack channels you add them to.
identity: A Slack app named "{brand.microsoft.appName}" in your workspace. It reads and posts only in channels someone adds it to, never in direct messages.

setup.title: Create the Slack app from a manifest
setup.body: Open Slack's app settings, select Create New App, then From a manifest, and choose your workspace. On the YAML tab, replace the example with this manifest, then select Next and Create. It asks only for the permissions the abilities you chose need.

setup.title: Install it and copy its token
setup.body: Install the app to your workspace, then copy its Bot User OAuth Token, which starts with xoxb-. If your workspace needs approval for new apps, a Slack admin approves it first.
click: api.slack.com/apps > {brand.microsoft.appName} > Install App > Install to your workspace > Allow
Install App > Bot User OAuth Token > Copy

setup.title: Add it to the channels agents may use
setup.body: The app sees only the channels it is a member of. In each channel agents should use, type /invite @{brand.microsoft.appName} and send it. You can narrow each agent to some of these channels here later.
click: The channel > the channel's name at the top > Integrations > Add an App > {brand.microsoft.appName} > Add

capabilities.label: Read channels
capabilities.description: List the channels the app was added to and read their messages and threads. Anyone who can post in those channels can write what the agent reads.
capabilities.forbidden: Add the bot scopes {scopes} to the Slack app under OAuth & Permissions, then reinstall it to the workspace.

capabilities.label: Post messages
capabilities.description: Post messages and thread replies as the app in its channels.
capabilities.forbidden: Add the bot scope chat:write to the Slack app under OAuth & Permissions, then reinstall it to the workspace.

capabilities.label: Add reactions
capabilities.description: Add emoji reactions to messages as the app.
capabilities.forbidden: Add the bot scope reactions:write to the Slack app under OAuth & Permissions, then reinstall it to the workspace.

capabilities.label: Share text files
capabilities.description: Share text files, such as reports, as the app in its channels.
capabilities.forbidden: Add the bot scope files:write to the Slack app under OAuth & Permissions, then reinstall it to the workspace.

capabilities.label: Find people by email
capabilities.description: Look up anyone in the workspace by email address: their Slack name, title and time zone.
capabilities.forbidden: Add the bot scopes users:read and users:read.email to the Slack app under OAuth & Permissions, then reinstall it to the workspace.

capabilities.label: Delete its own messages
capabilities.description: Delete messages the app posted. Slack cannot bring them back. The app can never delete anyone else's message.
capabilities.forbidden: Add the bot scope chat:write to the Slack app under OAuth & Permissions, then reinstall it to the workspace.

limits.label: Channels
limits.help: Leave empty to allow every channel the app is a member of.

discover.label: Channels the app is in
discover.ifEmpty: The app is not in any channel yet, so agents will find nothing. Add it to a channel with /invite, then check again.

revoke: In Slack's app settings, open {brand.microsoft.appName}, then Install App, and revoke its token, or remove the app from the workspace under Settings > Manage apps.
